title: Maribel Lopez：AI融资循环与全球竞争，中国模型崛起引发关注
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: Yeah, we are in this state where the revenue for the Frontier Model providers has not caught up with the spending that they had. The traditional capital markets would not do financing. So vendor financing is actually one of the best options that they have at this point, but it does lead into this.
segments.zh: 是的，我们处于前沿模型提供商的收入尚未赶上其支出的状态。传统资本市场不会提供融资，所以供应商融资实际上是他们目前最好的选择之一，但这确实导致了这个问题。

segments.en: If Nvidia says they're selling a lot of chips, but they're really vendor financing the chips to open AI, did they really make any money? So we do have a bit of a circular economy going on at this point in time, but it's not surprising.
segments.zh: 如果英伟达说他们卖了很多芯片，但实际上是通过供应商融资将芯片提供给OpenAI，他们真的赚钱了吗？所以目前确实存在一定的循环经济，但这并不令人意外。

segments.en: I think what we're all trying to figure out is this will be the most disruptive tech boom of our time, and the question is how fast and how broad is the monetization of that?
segments.zh: 我认为我们都在试图弄清楚的是，这将是当代最具颠覆性的科技繁荣，问题是变现的速度和广度如何？

segments.en: Because if you think about the companies that we've had in the past, we're looking at a whole different breed of companies being the companies of the future. Is it open AI? Is it anthropic? Will we continue to see someone like Microsoft who's been around for a significant period of time still be in that category, companies that's successful?
segments.zh: 因为如果你想想过去的公司，我们看到的未来公司将是完全不同的类型。是OpenAI？是Anthropic？我们是否会继续看到像微软这样存在已久的公司仍然属于成功公司的范畴？

segments.en: So these are the questions that people are asking, and what people are trying to figure out when they're investing is who will be the next company in the next 25, 30, 50 years?
segments.zh: 所以这些是人们正在问的问题，当人们配置资产时，他们试图弄清楚未来25年、30年、50年谁会是下一家公司？

segments.en: And Marital just quickly has the emergence of, I'll just use Kimi K3, but the emergence of these Chinese models, does that change that premise you just laid out there?
segments.zh: Maribel，快速问一下，像Kimi K3这样的中国模型的崛起，是否会改变你刚才提出的前提？

segments.en: I think there's been a tremendous discussion about how open-source models, the global model environment will impact the commercial revenue opportunity for the traditional foundation model providers. So I think we're in a state of tremendous innovation, tremendous opportunity for just wrapped across the globe. China's coming out to be quite a strong player in AI right now, and I think everybody is a bit concerned about what that will do to the U.S. economy.
segments.zh: 我认为关于开源模型、全球模型环境将如何影响传统基础模型提供商的商业收入机会，已经有了大量讨论。所以我认为我们正处于巨大的创新和机遇之中，遍及全球。中国在AI领域正成为相当强大的参与者，我认为每个人都有些担忧这对美国经济会有什么影响。
